title: Testing confirms Breece Hall's groin injury is minor, Jets to be cautious with RB

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Testing confirms Breece Hall's groin injury is minor, Jets to be cautious with RB
sources.description: The Jets had a bit of a scare during Monday’s practice, as star running back Breece Hall strained his groin. But by day's end were breathing a big sigh of relief.
